== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Strength]] [[Icon]], also referred to as the [[Fist Icon]] or the [[Symbol of Bodily Power]], is a manifestation of a powerful conceptual reality. As an [[Icon]], it serves as a symbol that individuals can contact to represent a specific concept deeply. The manifestation of such an [[Icon]] is determined by an individual's core identity and the nature of their [[madra]], requiring intense focus and years of willpower training. When utilized, the [[Strength]] [[Icon]] provides [[Authority|authority]] that can bend the physical rules of the world, similar to the abilities possessed by [[Monarchs]] or [[Heralds]]. It can be used to empower physical strikes, such as punches, and has been manifested by various figures including [[Northstrider]], the [[Netherworld Empress]], and [[Crusher]]. For some users, it can resonate with other [[Icons]] to serve a singular purpose or enhance their awareness of their surroundings.}}
